data.name: NoDesignerBlock
data.value: The file holds no form: it has no Begin block.

data.name: NotAFormRoot
data.value: {0} is not a form, a UserControl or a PropertyPage.
data.comment: {0} is the root block's class, such as VB.CommandButton.

data.name: MalformedLine
data.value: This line is not a Begin, an End or a property: {0}

data.name: UnbalancedBlock
data.comment: {0} is the block's name, or the stray End line.

data.name: UnreadLibraryReference
data.value: The control library {0} is not named by a type library id, so it is not listed.

data.name: UnmodelledClass
data.value: Class {0} of control {1} is not modelled, so the control is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the class, such as MSComctlLib.ListView; {1} is the control's name.

data.name: MisplacedComponent
data.value: {0} cannot hold {1}, so {1} is placed in {2}, where its position is read as written.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the component the file places it in; {1} is the component's name; {2} is the name of the container it is placed in.

data.name: InvalidValue
data.value: Property {0} in {1} had an invalid value, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the property's name; {1} is the component's name.

data.name: MissingCompanion
data.value: Property {0} in {1} cites {2}, which was not found.
data.comment: {0} is the property's name; {1} is the component's name; {2} is the binary file's name, such as Form1.frx.

data.name: MissingRecord
data.value: Property {0} in {1} cites offset {2} of {3}, which holds no record the property can read.
data.comment: {0} is the property's name; {1} is the component's name; {2} is the hexadecimal offset; {3} is the binary file's name.
